item.title: Later als ik dood ben (When I'm dead, later)
item.description:
🤖 This page was written in English with AI, based on the Dutch original. Read the original lyrics and chords in Dutch. The song is under copyright, so this page describes the song instead of translating the full lyrics.

Later als ik dood ben — what the song is about

Later als ik dood ben (“Later, when I’m dead”) is a Dutch song about what the singer hopes to be for the people he loves once he is gone.
